Q: How to target .NET Framework 4.0 in VS 2022 on Windows 11? A:
  • Download the reference assembly for .net40 from NuGet - https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETFramework.ReferenceAssemblies.net40/

  • rename the NuGet package downloaded as a .zip and extract it

  • copy paste the content of the folder build\.NETFramework into C:\Program files (x86)\Reference Assemblies\Microsoft\Framework\.NETFramework.

Q: How to cope with "intrin.h: No such file or directory"? A:

I have same problem. using eclipse + cdt + mingw32-gcc7.2 + glm (openGL math libraty) I replace #include <intrin.h> with #include <x86intrin.h> add flag to gcc -msse2 and all worked.
